prompt: Our Bullhorn OAuth connection in StackOne disconnected without warning. Is there a way to get notified when a linked account goes down, instead of finding out when calls start failing?
skill_note: Account lifecycle webhooks are platform territory.

fetch.name: fetches-account-events-docs
fetch.note: The Handle Account Events guide or the Webhooks page.

reply.name: mentions-webhooks
reply.note: Account status changes are delivered by webhook.

reply.name: names-account-events
reply.note: The events are subscribed by name on the webhook.

reference: Account lifecycle events are delivered by webhook, so the backend can react to a connection or disconnection instead of polling.

Account events are subscribed on the webhook itself, not on a connector profile, by setting the webhook's events array (account.created, account.updated, account.deleted) when creating or updating it.
The event payload carries the event name, account_id, provider and the origin identifiers, and the receiver should verify the signature before acting.
The docs describe account events as covering a user connecting or disconnecting; the reply maps the disconnection onto those events rather than inventing a separate alerting feature.
